name: kanban-board
title: Kanban board
description: Columns of cards moved between stages by drag, touch or keyboard, with counts, limits and Undo.

props.name: columns
props.description: The columns, in order.

props.name: items
props.description: Each column's cards, in order, by column id.

props.name: getItemId
props.description: A card's id: unique on the board, stable across moves.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.description: A card's name for screen readers, announcements and the toast: "Lumen Bank".

props.name: renderCard
props.description: The card itself, usually a `KanbanCard`.

props.name: onMove
props.type: (itemId: string, toColumn: string, index: number) => void
props.description: A card was dropped. `index` is its place in `toColumn` once it's there, from 0, counting loaded cards only (a column's `more` sit after them). Move it in `items` (`moveKanbanItem()` does it); until you do, the board shows it where it was.

props.name: canMove
props.description: Whether a card may go to a column. `true` allows it; anything else refuses, and a non-empty string is the reason ("Set a next step first"), shown under the lifted card and read out. Called once per column when a card lifts, and for the ⋯ menu; never for the card's own column.

props.name: confirmMove
props.type: (item: T, toColumn: string, index: number) => boolean | Promise<boolean>
props.description: Asked before `onMove`, for every real move (Undo skips it). `false` puts the card back. A promise keeps the card at its new place, dimmed and busy, until it settles: `true` moves it, `false` or a rejection puts it back. Open a Dialog from here to ask.

props.name: onShowMore
props.description: Makes a column's "+3 more" a button, which calls this with the column's id.

props.name: collapsedColumns
props.description: Collapsed columns, by id: a narrow strip with the title and count. Controlled.

props.name: defaultCollapsedColumns
props.description: Collapsed columns at first, when `collapsedColumns` isn't set.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: A collapse button in every column header, and an expand button on collapsed ones.

props.name: onAddItem
props.description: A + button in every column header, which calls this with the column's id.

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeleton cards in every column, and `aria-busy` on the board.

props.name: renderEmpty
props.description: What an empty column shows. Defaults to an EmptyState saying "No cards".

props.name: undoToast
props.description: The "Moved to Proposal" toast with Undo after a move to another column. Needs a `<Toaster />`.

props.name: columnWidth
props.description: A column's width in px.

KanbanCard.description: A card for `renderCard`, laid out like a sales pipeline's lead: Satin's Card (small) with a title row (logo, title, ⋯ menu), a status Badge and a line of meta under it, labelled `fields`, then a bottom row with the `footer`, the age (amber when `stale`) and an avatar. Children go between the fields and the bottom row. The ⋯ menu moves the card without dragging; it shows on hover and focus (always on touch screens). Other props, `ref` included, go to the Card.

props.name: title
props.description: What the card is: a company, a person, an order. A Link when it opens a page.

props.name: logo
props.description: Before the title, in the fields' icon column: a 16px logo, or a 16px Avatar (rounded for a company).

props.name: status
props.description: A Badge under the title for what's happening to it ("Nudged by agent · 2h"). Screen readers hear it as the card's description.

props.name: meta
props.description: One line under the title, in text/muted: a role, an amount, a date.

props.name: fields
props.description: Labelled lines, 8px apart: icon and value, each label for screen readers.

props.name: footer
props.description: The start of the bottom row: counts (comments, tasks), Badges.

props.name: age
props.description: How long it has been in its column ("3d"), with a clock, at the end of the bottom row.

props.name: stale
props.description: It has waited too long: the age turns into an amber Badge with an alert clock, and reads "stale".

props.name: avatar
props.description: An Avatar or AvatarGroup at the end of the bottom row: who owns it.

props.name: changed
props.description: A key for what the card shows (a version, an updated-at time). When it changes, not on first render nor when the card moves, the card lights up once and the board reads "Northwind Labs was updated". For changes nobody watched happen: an agent's, a teammate's.

props.name: actions
props.description: More DropdownMenuItems for the ⋯ menu, after the moves.

props.name: moveActions
props.description: "Move to" each other column, and up and down, in the ⋯ menu.
